verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is documented as a data-center AI accelerator, sold in DGX/HGX systems purpose-built for AI training and inference. Consumer gaming features such as DLSS or FSR upscaling and frame generation are outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence pack shows the part ships any gaming or upscaling capability, so the gaming axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
